title: Encoding issue
detail: Encoding the cookie string to 'latin1' and then decoding it can lead to data loss or corruption if the cookie contains characters not representable in 'latin1'. The same applies to line 1380.

title: Incorrect argument passing
detail: The `parse_cookie` function is called with `cookie` and `**kwargs`, but `parse_cookie` from `http` module does not accept `**kwargs`. This will cause a `TypeError` when `cls` or other keyword arguments are passed.

title: Incorrect argument passing
detail: The `parse_cookie` function is called with `combined_cookie` and `**kwargs`, but `parse_cookie` from `http` module does not accept `**kwargs`. This will cause a `TypeError` when `cls` or other keyword arguments are passed.

title: Incorrect domain boundary handling
detail: The line `host = host.lstrip('.')` removes a leading dot from the no_proxy host, which can lead to incorrect domain boundary matching. For example, if `no_proxy` contains `.d.o.t`, removing the leading dot will cause it to match `d.o.t` instead of `.d.o.t`. The same applies to line 857.

title: Incorrect set comprehension
detail: The set comprehension is incorrectly using the breakpoint value instead of the class name, which will lead to incorrect removal of classes.
